summary: Chromium completed all 70 task-02 Playwright cases (70 expected, zero skipped, unexpected or flaky), covering every specified RO/EN desktop width, long and empty metadata, mobile boundaries, rapid interactions, keyboard traversal, and real pointer/keyboard activation of all nine header actions. Root npm test discovery includes 227 cases in eight files; node tests/verify.js and the gdsync, wbsaveall, task-01 row and task-03 buttons regression suites completed without new failures. The current browser JSON report and three RO screenshots are retained in this task directory. No task-02 product defect was reproduced. This test round fails its required commit step: git add -A && git commit exited 128 because Git could not create .git/index.lock on the read-only filesystem; no commit was created, and the refused command was not retried. The hook's historical idea/nav failures remain outside this task.
